title: How early microbial encounters shape adult behavior
content:
by Kyu-Chan Cho, Won-Jae Lee

Microbes are increasingly recognized as modulators of host behavior, but the underlying mechanisms are poorly understood. A new PLOS Biology study reveals a microbiome-to-gut-to-neuron pathway linking developmental microbial exposure to later food avoidance.
